title: Amariah
sourceLines: -2. Chief priest in the reign of Jehoshaphat 2Ch 19:11
-3. A high priest, father of Ahitub 1Ch 6:11; Ezr 7:3
-4. A Levite, who assisted in distributing temple gifts 2Ch 31:15-19
-7. A priest, returned from exile Ne 10:3; 12:2
.Probably identical with one mentioned in Ne 12:13
-8. A returned exile. Divorces his idolatrous wife Ezr 10:42
